verdicts.reason: The two candidates look pixel-identical in this 320x50 banner, so neither is better. Both share the same flaws: the price cards are out of order (6, 80, 48, so the dark Yearly card has moved off the centre spot it held as the featured plan), the plan labels and 'per month/year' text are unreadably small, the subtitle is squashed into a tiny three-line block under the logo, and the legal text is a gray smear. The headline and the orange CTA do read clearly and in the right left-to-right order.
